text:
ada (CEO): Good morning everyone — brief exec weekly. Next 2 weeks focus: 1) finish EU Private GA checklist; 2) tighten latency SLOs for hosted API; 3) finalize Dedicated pricing tiers. High-level metrics: hosted request p95 latency 220ms (down from 260), cost/1k tokens down ~6% after batching changes. We hit a small incident on Wed (region us-west) that impacted ~1.2% of requests; Laura will summarize. Asks: teams, please ack the EU GA compliance doc by EOD Thu; finance needs committed numbers for Dedicated by next Mon; product to freeze any new model onboarding for 48h during GA cutover. More below.

mike (VP Product): Quick notes on freeze — product accepts 48h freeze, exceptions need my sign-off. We'll push the rollout window: `2026-04-05 -> 2026-04-09` for staged canaries.

jordyn (CFO): Finance checkpoint — expected uplift from Dedicated signups: runway-neutral in Q3 if we secure two enterprise contracts. Need headcount-based cost model by Friday. I'll schedule time with infra leads.

laura (Head Eng-SRE): Incident summary: Wed 04/01 @ 02:14 UTC — KV cache eviction race during a config push caused elevated token latency in us-west. Root cause: async cache invalidation bug in runtime v3.2.2. Mitigation: rollback to v3.2.1 at 02:29 UTC, autoscaling absorbed burst, customer-facing errors ~0.6% of requests, no data loss. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-04-01-kv-evict (please review). Action items: 1) revert-in-place test added; 2) circuit-breaker default lowered to 60s; 3) add canary for cache invalidation paths.

ops-bot: deploy: v3.2.3 -> canary -> scheduled 2026-04-03 11:00 UTC. Rollout policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% if no errors.

ada (CEO): Two executive asks: 1) Sales/CS: capture 3 anchor customers for Dedicated who can join beta; Olivia pls coordinate. 2) DevEx/Docs: update quickstart with EU region examples and a short checklist for Private installs.

olivia (Head Sales): On it — I have two leads already interested. Will set up calls with Solutions Eng this week.

mike (VP Product): Also note: Redwood Optimize alpha pilot starts next Tuesday. If you have workloads to add, ping me. Expected improvements in cost/unit will vary by model, avg ~10%.

ada (CEO): Thanks everyone. Short Q/A at 2pm PT today. Please bring any blockers. :thumbsup:

laura (Head Eng-SRE): acked. I'll circulate the postmortem by EOD for review.

jordyn (CFO): ack — scheduling finance sync for Friday.

ada (CEO): end.
